digest.component_or_area: blame tracking and caused_by link derivation
propositions: A one-time backfill script must retroactively draw caused_by links on existing closed bugs using the conservative single-culprit blame resolver.
The script must be idempotent by checking for existing active caused_by edges via _is_active_link before writing new links to avoid duplicates.
The backfill must reuse the same deterministic resolver logic as live auto-derivation to ensure consistency between backfilled and forward-going caused_by links.
The script must default to --dry-run mode for safety and skip bugs with ambiguous culprits or existing caused_by links.
Test must verify exactly one caused_by link is drawn for single-culprit bugs and zero for ambiguous bugs, and that re-running the script in write mode produces no new links.
